_about: F32: the console-visit note — the first few times (content/tuning/lessons.json consoleNoteVisits) the player goes to the console mid-shift outside a lesson, this one line shows on the monitor's screen (src/game/lessons/firstBreakdowns.ts) until they're back in the tank or for a short while: lesson time runs at the console's speed (25%), so 1.5 s here = 6 s. No dim and no Got it (F32): the tank runs on, the panels and the periscope stay usable, and the line fits the screen without sliding it down over the periscope. Words: content/text/en.json → lessons.console-note.
